messages:
Ava Chen: Morning — quick standup from sales side. Pipeline snapshot: NovaGrid (LOI), HelixCare (security review), Citrine Labs (pilot eval). Main blocker: HelixCare asking for detailed encryption + network topology for Private deployment.
Devon Patel: NovaGrid update: finance sent final SOW yesterday, waiting signatures. No blockers.
Priya Nair: Citrine Labs wants a short demo focused on streaming latency and cost per 1k tokens — can we do a 20-min deep-dive this week? Prefer Thurs PST.
Ava Chen: @Priya yes pls schedule. Prefer demo with Liam on hand for any runtime Qs.
Liam O'Connor: I can do Thurs. For HelixCare: what exact artifacts do they want? network diagram + KMS flow?
Riley Strauss: HelixCare asked for: 1) encryption at rest details (KMS integration + rotation), 2) network isolation diagram (VPC peering / ingress rules), 3) audit log retention policy. Also they want to know who has access to plaintext during support.
Devon Patel: ok noted. @Riley can you confirm whether we can provide a one-pager for support access? HelixCare security is NSO-heavy.
Riley Strauss: We can provide policies and an access matrix; for customer-managed Private, there is no Redwood access to plaintext by default. I'll draft a short FAQ.
Priya Nair: For Citrine, they care about streaming start latency and tail p99. Liam can you bring perf slides + a small demo of prefix caching?
Liam O'Connor: Yep — will include p50/p95/p99 charts and a demo with prefix cache on a 2k token convo.
Ava Chen: Action items: Devon follow up on NovaGrid signatures; Priya schedule Citrine Thurs demo; Riley draft HelixCare FAQ + network diagram; Liam prepare perf + demo; I'll consolidate and send to HelixCare legal.
Devon Patel: Quick ask — NovaGrid mentioned SOC2 type 2 in contract. Do we have an updated cert link?
Riley Strauss: SOC2 link: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/soc2-2025.pdf. I'll confirm the date and attach.
opsbot: deploy-notify: Dedicated capacity rollout to us-east-1 started at 1832104800, expected completion 10m.
Ava Chen: heads up — if deployment impacts demos Thurs, will flag.
Priya Nair: Scheduling note: Citrine prefers 11am PST, sending calendar now.
Devon Patel: NovaGrid finance call scheduled 1832180000, I'll ping when it's done.
Liam O'Connor: For HelixCare network diagram, do we need to show NAT/egress rules?
Riley Strauss: Include egress controls and optional private endpoints + HSM/KMS flow. I'll attach a minimal diagram.
Ava Chen: thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker connecting security artifacts, tag me and I'll escalate to Solutions Eng leadership. :thumbsup:
Devon Patel: One more — Citrine asked if we can provide an estimated cost for 100k monthly tokens with batching. @Liam can you approximate?
Liam O'Connor: I'll run numbers and post a short calc in this thread by EOD.
Ava Chen: last: please update the shared pipeline doc after you complete your items (link: https://redwood.example.com/pipeline).
Priya Nair: will do.
Riley Strauss: Draft FAQ + diagram by EOD.
Devon Patel: updating NovaGrid status now.
opsbot: uptime: all systems nominal.
